name: Thunder Falls
summary: Thunder Falls lies in Elwynn Forest’s northwestern heights, where bandits have taken a riverside cottage.

sections.title: A Hidden Mountain Hollow
sections.body: Thunder Falls cuts through the ridges above Mirror Lake, where a mountain stream rushes between steep cliffs. It enters over an unreachable cascade in the north, then spills away in waterfalls on both sides. One fall empties into Mirror Lake; the stream’s downstream course runs west toward Westfall’s rugged border. A cottage, dock, and outdoor forge sit beside the water. Bandits now claim the clearing.

faq.q: How do you reach Thunder Falls?
aliases: how to get to thunder falls
faq.answer: Reach Thunder Falls from the northern side of Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest. A steep, narrow trail climbs into the hills beside the waterfall’s right side and leads into the ravine.

faq.q: Who lives in the cottage at Thunder Falls?
faq.answer: The cottage at Thunder Falls appears to have belonged to a solitary fisherman or frontiersman, with a dock, rowing boat, and outdoor anvil nearby. Bandits operating in Elwynn Forest now use it as a remote hideout.

faq.q: Where does the river at Thunder Falls flow?
faq.answer: The stream runs through the narrow mountain gap from an upper cascade. It passes the cottage, then plunges down a steep waterfall near Westfall’s eastern boundary.
